title: Editorial: Check the associated Document when finishing navigation
body:
Check the associated Document of the NavigateEvent relevant global object for full activity in the handler-success steps.

The relevant global object is a Window, while fully active is a Document state. This matches the checks in the commit and failure paths in the same section.

Spec: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#navigate-event-intercept-commit-handler-steps
